description.value: A McDonald's fast-food restaurant in Richmond, BC, located on Alderbridge Way with drive-through and indoor seating. As a national chain outlet, it offers a familiar menu of burgers, chicken, breakfast items, McCafé beverages, and seasonal specials. Touring cyclists passing through the Richmond area will find it a convenient and predictable stop for a quick meal or snack.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetched is the national McDonald's Canada homepage (mcdonalds.ca), which contains no location-specific information for the Richmond outlet at 8191 Alderbridge Way; all amenity claims must rely on OSM tags. OSM confirms takeaway=yes, indoor_seating=yes, drive_through=yes, and internet_access=wlan, but per the rules OSM amenity tags are not treated as authoritative without website corroboration. Bike parking, water refill, and washroom details are not evidenced by either source.
concerns: Website URL resolves to the national McDonald's Canada homepage (mcdonalds.ca), not a location-specific page; no location-level amenity details (Wi-Fi, washrooms, bike parking) could be verified from the website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast-food restaurant in Richmond. A useful stop for touring cyclists needing food, beverages, or a rest.
